items.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: So she said let’s go down to Washington and interview him. And that’s how that came about. We went down there and we put him on camera

ctx.x: You got to collaborate with Congressman John Conyers.

Well we didn’t collaborate. Actually in the documentary movie that Anja Baron did on the band, the first documentary movie, I had shown her what the proclamation that John Conyers had made about jazz, that it should be promulgated and respected and so on and so forth. So she said let’s go down to Washington and interview him. And that’s how that came about. We went down there and we put him on camera and so he’s in the movie.
What did your wife and daughter think of this passion of yours?
